summary_en: Serverworks will acquire the remaining 33.4% stake in G-gen held by Newberry Global Japan for an undisclosed price, bringing its ownership to 100%. The acquisition is scheduled for October 30, 2026. G-gen, established in 2021 as a joint venture, operates Google Cloud services and was merged with Topgate in July 2024.
title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Subsidiary Acquisition through Additional Acquisition of Subsidiary Shares
translation_en_brief:
Serverworks Co., Ltd. decided on October 23, 2026, to acquire the remaining 33.4% stake in its consolidated subsidiary G-gen from Newberry Global Japan LLC, scheduled to close on October 30, 2026. The acquisition price is undisclosed due to confidentiality obligations with the counterparty, but the company states that the valuation was determined through a fair process based on independent third-party appraisal and negotiations, reflecting fair value. Following the acquisition, Serverworks will hold 100% of G-gen, increasing from the current 66.6%.

G-gen was established in 2021 as a joint venture between Serverworks and the Bespin Global Inc. group (now Newberry Global Japan) to develop Google Cloud services. In June 2022, Serverworks acquired Topgate, a leading Google Cloud provider, as a subsidiary. The two companies merged in July 2024, with Topgate as the surviving entity, which was then renamed G-gen. G-gen now serves as the core company for Serverworks' Google Cloud strategy within its multi-cloud operations.

By achieving 100% ownership, Serverworks aims to accelerate decision-making, promote unified business strategy across the group, strengthen coordination of sales operations, and improve mutual utilization of technical talent. The company expects that these benefits will support optimal allocation of management resources and enhance overall group enterprise value.
